selected_project.title: Project Meridian — Retrieval-Augmented Support-Docs RAG
bullets: Designed a production-shaped RAG architecture combining hybrid BM25 + HNSW vector retrieval with reciprocal rank fusion and cross-encoder reranking over a 40k-article internal support-documentation corpus.

Built a quantitative evaluation harness (Recall@k, nDCG@k, MRR, LLM-judged faithfulness) that gated a cost/latency optimization pass, cutting cost 24% and latency 33% while keeping Recall@10 within two points of baseline.
